en.text:
Each Direct Hit grants 25% progress to your 'Enrage'. Enrage linearly increases your rate of fire up to 126 RPM (40% increase) at maximum level. 

Entering Critical Health instantly grants max Enrage.

Enrage's progress constantly decays at a rate of ?% per second over 9.5 seconds. While you are at Critical Health, Enrage does not decay.
